delegated_acceptance_review: Actually viewed final MaSSFormer architecture, read source pp4-5 and equations 1-3, and reviewed all independent checks. Full original encoder/decoder, three module insets, legend, features, input and edge map remain intact. Added sidebar correctly distinguishes early low-resolution D4, CST higher-resolution D3, RFB combination with S2, LSE image/S1 branch, edge-guided D1, and D2-D4 transformer inputs. These are explicit in source text; sidebar introduces no new internal edge or feature index.
